description: This file defines the base class for all PDF content stream objects and various derived classes representing specific PDF content entities, such as comments, sequences, strings, numbers, names, arrays, and operators, within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: CObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for all PDF content stream objects, providing cloning and writing functionality.

classes.name: CComment
classes.description: Represents a comment in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CSequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of PDF content objects, implementing list-like behavior and content serialization.

classes.name: CNumber
classes.description: Abstract class for numerical PDF objects.

classes.name: CInteger
classes.description: Represents an integer value in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CReal
classes.description: Represents a real (floating-point) number in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CString
classes.description: Represents a string value in a PDF content stream, including different string types.

classes.name: CName
classes.description: Represents a name object in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CArray
classes.description: Represents an array of PDF content objects.

classes.name: COperator
classes.description: Represents an operator in a PDF content stream, with its operands and associated behavior.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the object; meant to be overridden in derived classes.
